decisions.reason: The conditional order for five additional videos does not change who must provide scripts, footage, or voiceover.
The pilot expansion condition does not change the required lip-sync accuracy or natural facial-expression behavior.
The source changes only the quantity and ordering condition for follow-on videos; it does not resolve or modify the production-method conflict.
The conditional follow-on order does not alter the specified target audience age range.
Testing the pilot before ordering five more videos does not modify the campaign's winning-creative objective or its below-₹80 cost-per-lead target.
